Maya Patel: Quick triage — noticed user report that optimize/toolkit's batching.md JS snippet recommends batchSize=32 but our JS SDK now uses 'maxBatch' and the sample comment suggests 'p95' but should be 'p99'. Link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/issues/5632
Evan Brooks: Thanks. I also saw a small UX wording issue in optimize/kv-prefetch.md: the wording "recommended TTL" is ambiguous. We should be explicit: "recommended TTL (per-key cache duration)" and show units.
Lina Zhou: I'll take the JS snippet rename and wording change. Will also add a short heuristic comment: "start with maxBatch = Math.min(64, Math.ceil(throughput / 4))" and note latency tradeoffs.
doc-bot: [automated] samplegen detected 2 failing examples in branch docs/opt-sprint-5632: optimize/batching.md (js snippet), optimize/kv-prefetch.md (doc wording mismatch). CI logs: https://ci.internal.redwood/ci/5632/logs
Evan Brooks: Can we add a compile/runtime smoke test for JS snippets in examples/test_examples.js? If we run `node --check` or a tiny mocha test to require the snippet it will catch regressions.
Lina Zhou: Good idea. I'll add a compile-only test that requires the generated sample file. Patch includes: examples/test_examples.js + adjusted batching.md snippet. Draft PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5633
Maya Patel: Also, the quant-profile link in kv-prefetch pointed to an old anchor. Please update to /optimize/quant-profiles#quant-profiles-table and add a redirect note at top of that page so old links don't 404.
Lina Zhou: Updated anchor, added redirect comment, and fixed TTL wording to "TTL (e.g., 30s, 5m)" in kv-prefetch.md. Included a short migration note for older links.
QA-bot: [automated] samplegen v0.4.3 run queued for PR #5633 — will report back with artifact + failing snippet list.
Evan Brooks: Once CI passes, please squash/merge. Also file DOCS-912 to sweep optimize/ for other small UX wording and anchor mismatches. Assign to docs-rotation.
Maya Patel: Filed DOCS-912 and assigned to docs-rotation. Thanks team — let's ship the fix today if CI is green. Lina, can you ping when merged?
Lina Zhou: Will do. Patch pushed and CI rerun requested. :rocket:
